Would you like an internship where your analyses help drive real business decisions? Are you excited by the opportunity to work with data, AI and modern analytics tools in an international green-tech company? Does gaining hands-on experience with Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI sound like the perfect foundation for your future career?

Here is what your role entails

As our new Data Analyst Intern, your responsibility will be to help Customer Services transform data into insights that support business decisions and continuous improvements.

More specifically, you will be:

• Analyzing Customer Services performance

• Identifying improvement opportunities

• Tracking costs and income streams

• Developing dashboards and tracking KPIs

• Exploring data-driven and AI opportunities

This internship offers the opportunity to work with real business challenges, where your insights create impact. You will gain hands-on experience with technologies and platforms such as Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI while helping shape a newly established area with plenty of room for learning and development. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to influence your focus areas throughout the internship based on your interests and development goals.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to Head of Service Development - Heat/Cooling Customer Services, you will become part of a newly established team in Customer Services focused on service development, business processes, and data analysis. Together our mission is to enable Customer Services to continuously improve how we deliver, support, and develop services. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and you can expect close interaction with colleagues from Customer Services as well as Product Management, Sales, Software Development and Digitalization. As a team, we value knowledge sharing, professional sparring, and a strong desire to continuously improve the way we work.

Did you know? In our team, we have many different talents – we have both a former professional drummer, a race car driver and one of the best board game players in Denmark, just to name a few.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and analytical student who enjoys working with data and turning insights into action. You are motivated by solving real business challenges and eager to explore how data and AI can create value in practice.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field

• Have strong analytical skills and is comfortable working with quantitative data

• Have an interest in working with AI and tools such as Power BI or similar visualization tools

As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Consulting and Application Services. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best. Either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Customer dialogue and requirements clarification.

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or have a couple of years of experience. Most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Complex international HVAC projects demand more than strong project plans. They require disciplined commercial leadership, reliable cross-functional execution, and timely decisions across markets, contracts, and technical disciplines.

NOVENCO are looking for a Director of Project Execution to lead NOVENCO’s project portfolio across Denmark, Netherlands, UK, DACH, APAC and US. You will strengthen how we deliver safely, profitably, and consistently from order handover to final customer acceptance and satisfaction.

****Your Impact

• Lead the Project Execution function across NOVENCO, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and contractually compliant delivery.

• Set the functional direction, operating model, governance standards, and long-term capability roadmap for Project Execution.

• Own portfolio performance across revenue, gross margin, cash flow, working capital, forecasting, risk, quality, and customer commitments.

• Lead and develop Project Managers and project execution teams through clear priorities, effective decision rights, succession planning, and coaching.

• Align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, installation, and commissioning around common delivery plans and commercial outcomes.

• Guide major customer escalations, contractual negotiations, claims, recovery actions, and commercial decisions within NOVENCO’s delegated authority framework.

****What Drives Success

• Extensive leadership experience from international HVAC, mechanical contracting, EPC, construction, or industrial project delivery.

• Proven accountability for a complex project portfolio, including margin, cash, risk, forecasting, contracts, and customer escalations.

• Strong financial and organizational judgement that turns business strategy into clear priorities, governance, and executable plans.

• The ability to lead experienced professionals and Project managers across functions, cultures, countries, and competing commercial priorities.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience; PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2, or comparable certification is an advantage.

****Real Impact Example

****A major international project portfolio is facing changing customer requirements, capacity constraints, margin pressure, and several contractual interfaces. You enable your team to establish a fact-based portfolio review, clarify decision rights, strengthen change control, and align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and project leadership around a shared recovery plan. Within short time the team improves forecast accuracy, and brings critical projects back within their approved delivery plans. Just as importantly, the new governance becomes a repeatable standard across all four countries.

****What We Offer

• A leadership role with responsibility for international project execution across NOVENCO’s established markets.

• The opportunity to shape NOVENCO’s Project Execution strategy, operating model, leadership capability, and delivery standards.

• Direct influence on the commercial and operational performance of complex, technically demanding HVAC projects.

• Close collaboration with senior leadership and experienced colleagues across commercial, technical, financial, and operational functions.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

****Context

****You will lead a team of 8-10 people across NOVENCO and report directly to the CEO. The position combines strategic functional leadership with regular engagement in major projects and customer relationships.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Location: On-site with possibility to work remote

Team: Data & AI

Seniority: Mid-Level to Senior

**About The Platform

**Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

**What You Will Do

****Event Processing & Pipelines

**

• Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query

• Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics

• Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems

• Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

**Detection & Enrichment Services

**

• Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring

• Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty

• Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release

• Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

**APIs & Integration

**

• Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services

• Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)

• Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers

• Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

**Running What We Build

**

• Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer

• Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

**What You Bring

****Required Qualifications

**

• Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development

• Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it

• Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes

• Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment

• Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment

• Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution

• Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge

• Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)

• Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

**Nice to Have

****Experience with any of the following is a plus:

**Platform and engineering breadth

• Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)

• Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)

• Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)

• Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)

• Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)

• Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)

• Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

• Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns

• Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

**Domain

**

• Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)

• Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic

• Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

**Machine learning and data science

**

• Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning

• MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)

• Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies

• Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data

• Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

**Why Join Us

**You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

Spirii is looking for an Engineering Manager!

If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

The Job

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working. As Engineering Manager, you lead 1-2 of our engineering teams of 6–12 engineers and are accountable for making it a high-performing team. You own the people, the health of the team and the soundness of its engineering. You do this through others: Tech Leads and Senior Engineers guide the technical work day-to-day, and you make sure good decisions get made, quality stays high, and the team keeps getting better.

Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

What You Will Do

Lead and grow your people

• 
Own the full people cycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, feedback, career development, performance reviews and handling underperformance early and fairly.

• 
Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

• 
Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

Own team performance

• 
Be accountable for the team's delivery, predictability and quality, and for how it improves over time.

• 
Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

• 
Turn priorities into clear commitments, make trade-offs visible, and protect the team so committed work gets finished.

Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

• 
Make agentic development part of how your team works every day, moving beyond individual experiments to shared practice.

• 
Adapt how work flows through your team as agents take on more of the building. That includes how work is specified, how code is reviewed and how quality is assured.

• 
Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

• 
Work with colleagues across engineering on how we adopt agentic development. Bring your team's needs and feedback, and help test and roll out new tools and practices.

• 
Track what agentic development changes for your team's delivery and quality, and share what you learn with other teams.

Ensure sound engineering

• 
Be accountable for the quality of your team's engineering decisions, including architecture, security, operational readiness, observability and technical debt, while your Tech Lead and engineers lead the design work.

• 
Make sure what the team ships is tested, observable and ready to run in production, and that incidents lead to real learning.

• 
Work with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to keep our platform and practices coherent across teams.

Collaborate across Spirii

• 
Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• 
Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

Who You Are

• 
You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

• 
You hold a high bar for quality and for yourself, and you take ownership of results.

• 
You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

• 
You're technical enough to challenge a design, read an incident and spot risk, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

• 
You communicate clearly with engineers, product people and leadership alike.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has relevant experience with development of digital cloud-based solutions in an agile start-up environment and can take the responsibility for leading a team of developers.

We further look for a candidate with the following experience and personal traits:

• 
Relevant technical graduate degree at minimum bachelor level (engineer).

• 
3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager with direct reports, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• 
A background as a software engineer (backend or full-stack) building cloud-based solutions.

• 
Solid understanding of distributed systems, such as microservices and APIs, and what it takes to run them reliably in production.

• 
Experience improving engineering practices like automated testing, CI/CD, observability or incident management.

• 
Familiarity with DORA metrics or similar ways of measuring delivery.

• 
Experience making senior engineers and tech leads more effective, rather than doing their work for them.

It's an advantage if you have

• 
Experience leading a team's adoption of AI-assisted or agentic development, including changing practices, not just introducing tools.

• 
Experience with AWS and containerised workloads.

• 
Experience from eMobility products.

• 
Experience leading a team through organisational change.

jobs.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a talented Field Service Engineer based in Ballerup, Denmark or in Southern Germany. The ideal candidate has a minimum of 7 years of experience in servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment**.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Service Engineer to join Sophion Bioscience’s small, dedicated service team.

You will work alongside curious, hands-on colleagues who solve problems, share knowledge, and support one another - even when working independently in the field.

The team values high-quality work, clear communication, and a straightforward, respectful customer experience. In this key role, you will ensure the reliable performance of our automated patch clamp and organ-on-a-chip instruments at customer sites. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs, system evaluations, customer training, and coordinating upgrades with cross-functional teams.

As an ambassador for Sophion, you will build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively and resolving technical issues promptly, helping drive the continued growth of Sophion Bioscience.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ On a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Installation and Commissioning: Conducting on-site installation and commissioning of Sophion Automated Patch Clamp and Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring it meets the client's specifications and quality standards.

• Maintenance and Repairs: Performing routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of QPatch, Qube and Ethica M systems to ensure uninterrupted functionality. Responding promptly to service requests and providing timely resolutions.

• Documentation: Creating detailed service reports, documentation, and maintaining accurate records of all service activities. Providing feedback to the engineering and R&D teams for continuous product improvement.

• Training: Providing training to clients on the proper usage, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Sophion automated patch clamp & Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring they have a clear understanding of its features and capabilities.

• Customer Support: Serving as a point of contact for technical support, addressing client inquiries, and maintaining strong relationships with customers to enhance satisfaction.

• Collaboration: Collaborating with the Sales, Application Science and Engineering teams to communicate client feedback, potential product enhancements, and identify opportunities for upselling additional services or products.

Who You Are

You are an experienced service professional with a passion for customer success, technical excellence, and being a team player. You thrive in a hands-on environment where no two days are the same and enjoy executing your day-to-day responsibilities in close collaboration with the rest of the Sophion team.

We imagine that you:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Biomedical Engineering, a related field or equivalent certifications

• In-depth knowledge of liquid handling devices from various industry systems is a benefit.

• Experience with electrical and pneumatics preferred

• Must possess a good grasp of core engineering concepts which include the ability to read and interpret electrical/circuit Schematic drawings.

• Able to use test/measuring equipment like Digital Multimeter (DVM).

• Team player, critical thinker, and flexible for effective performance in the field.

• Experience with service management systems and processes

• Familiarity with the operation and maintenance of Festo pressure systems is a plus

• Manage MySQL and Oracle databases to ensure seamless system integration and performance.

• Network Configuration and Maintenance: configure and troubleshoot network setups, routers, and DHCP configurations to guarantee optimal system connectivity.

• Possess a basic understanding of Linux systems to address software and operating system-related challenges.

• Demonstrate excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to address technical issues promptly.

• Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues, ensuring a positive and collaborative working place.

• Ability to travel 50-60% once initial training is complete.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the HR Director, Helene Fife, (+45 51 20 34 43).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Do you want a broad accounting role with significant responsibility and excellent development opportunities?

If you are an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership, working independently, and being part of a collaborative team, this could be exactly the opportunity you have been looking for.

At Gubra, we are experiencing continued growth and development. As our business expands, so do the opportunities for our employees to develop professionally and take on increasing responsibility. We are therefore looking for a Financial Accountant to join our Finance team and contribute to maintaining a high level of quality, compliance, and operational excellence across our group companies.

In this role, you will become part of our finance function where teamwork, trust, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

A broad accounting role with responsibility across multiple areas

As Financial Accountant, you will be responsible for a variety of accounting and controlling activities spanning day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing activities, reporting support, and audit preparation.

You will have ownership of your own areas while working closely with your colleagues in Finance. We take pride in supporting one another and working together to ensure successful month-end closings, reporting deadlines, audits, and daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Managing accounts receivable, including invoicing, cash registrations, reminders, and communication with customers' finance departments

• Maintaining and managing the fixed asset register, including verification of physical assets and correct accounting treatment

• Handling lease accounting in accordance with IFRS 16

• Performing foreign currency revaluations on currency accounts

• Acting as system owner for Corpay, PLEO, and e-conomic

• Preparing statutory and regulatory reporting, including submissions to Statistics Denmark and other authorities

• Supporting colleagues with accounting- and finance-related questions

• Participating in month-end closing activities, reconciliations, and audit preparation

• Contributing to process improvements, internal controls, and finance-related projects

• Supporting ad hoc tasks across the group's legal entities

As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and actively influence how we develop our finance processes and controls.

An experienced accounting professional with a proactive mindset

Naturally, we are looking for someone with the right professional qualifications. However, your approach to work and collaboration is equally important.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through on commitments, and enjoys working in an environment that combines structured routines with changing priorities and deadlines.

In addition, you bring:

• You likely have 5+ years of experience from a finance function where you have worked independently with bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing, and financial controls.

• Strong Excel skills and experience with financial systems

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your areas

• A positive and collaborative mindset with a willingness to support colleagues across the organization

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

Experience from an international company with entities in multiple countries is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Likewise, experience with Corpay, PLEO, and/or e-conomic is beneficial but not essential.

We are particularly interested in someone who is curious and analytical. You notice when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and work proactively to find a solution rather than simply reporting the deviation.

Your new team

You will join a Finance team consisting of four colleagues, including yourself. We work closely together, share knowledge, and support one another in delivering high-quality financial operations.

The role can be structured as either a full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week), depending on your preferences and qualifications.

We look forward to welcoming a colleague who enjoys being part of a team while maintaining ownership of their own responsibilities.

What we offer

• A broad and independent role in a collaborative Finance team

• A full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week)

• Real responsibility and ownership from day one

• The opportunity to influence processes, workflows, and internal controls

• Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility of working from home

• Ongoing opportunities to develop your role and responsibilities

• An informal and positive working environment

• Dedicated colleagues and a strong team spirit

• Competitive salary based on qualifications

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Start date as soon as possible, although we are happy to wait for the right candidate

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!
